checks: First write creates missing save directories and preserves exact Unicode JSON bytes without a BOM
Replacing a save commits the new snapshot and retains the previous complete snapshot in .bak
Repeated commits retain the immediately preceding snapshot, including when .bak already exists
A stale temporary file is replaced by a fresh transaction and is never loaded as a save
A staging-path failure preserves both committed files and propagates the storage error
Windows replacement against a locked save fails safely, retains both snapshots, and cleans the staged file
A null snapshot is rejected before touching an existing save
An empty save path is rejected before file operations
